name: spireflow
description: Hold a key, speak, and your words appear in any app. Local dictation powered by Phonon-2.
author: Spireflow

scripts.setup:py: py -m venv server/.venv && server/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r server/requirements.txt
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:sidecar && npm run stage:model && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:sidecar && npm run stage:model && electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run stage:model && electron-builder --dir
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
